dll_source: a47461d0 native kernel; only read-only numeric_update_context and binding added, no combat advance changes; baseline does not call new method. Both sides same binary.
acceptance: Report peak and average effects separately, including ordinary-frame regressions. Parent judges spike value; no mechanical all-metrics-positive rule. No claimed attribution gain used as frame gain.
precondition: 122 focused checks pass on weapon value exit; previous numeric update344 checks pass. Single diagnostic preserves state/events and confirms unused values exit.
scope: Same full busy scene,true1x60Hz uncapped, original purchases/research/exploration/effects,saves disabled,D-only isolated project.

statistics.all: Every measured frame: n,mean,median,p95,p99,max; no deletion
statistics.boundary: Frames crossing steps60,120,180,240; list every frame with index/step/ms and aggregate mean/median/tails
statistics.following: Next recorded frame after each boundary if available; final boundary may have no following sample. List all and report stats.
statistics.ordinary: Excludes boundary and following frames; nonboundary additionally includes following for direct prior comparison. All-frame results always retain every sample.
statistics.quantiles: Sorted element at min(n-1,int(n*p)), consistent with preceding runs.
statistics.pairs: All three A-minus-B differences for every section and metric; positive means candidate faster. No reruns or selection.
